title: Plan Pre-deploy Tests
bottom_line: Run it in your app's repo. Answer a few questions, approve the coverage summary, and get test sessions, each with its own model.

sections.heading: Run it in the app's repository

blocks.caption: With no argument, a later run plans only what changed since the last plan. --full plans everything again.

blocks.text: It needs the `plan-tools`, `model-picker` and `user-flows` plugins, which install with it, and a git repository. It plans only: it runs no test and changes no app code.

blocks.title: What it detects before asking
rows: A web framework and none of the above

blocks.title: What you are asked
rows: Web only, web + native, native only; iOS, Android or both
Portrait only, or portrait and landscape
Tested only if you support it. Chromium and WebKit are always tested.
Asked only when the code has them
The default branch run locally, or an integration environment URL

blocks.text: The detected answer comes first. A later run asks only the test target and the highest model. For a local target on a project not made from a template, it also asks once how to start the app on a given port and database.

nodes.label: Test spec drafted
nodes.note: Every item traces to a user flow, a screen or a source file.

nodes.label: Model per session
nodes.note: A pick above your highest model gets that model with one more effort level.

nodes.label: Summary shown
nodes.note: Areas, platforms, sizes, sessions and their models.

blocks.text: If `user-flows.md` exists, every flow becomes a test item. If not, it offers to extract the flows first, or plans from the code.

blocks.title: Areas it covers
items: Logic: user flows, validation, permissions, data changes, errors, double submits, session expiry, existing test suites.
UI: layout, every size and orientation, typography, color and dark mode, states, forms, navigation, modals, scrolling, touch, animation, browsers.
Native shell: safe areas, status bar, keyboard, splash, permissions, background and resume, offline, tablets.

blocks.title: Files in .pre-deploy-tests/
rows: `sessions/session-NN.md`: one per session, with its model, effort, platform copies and what it covers
`record.json`: what the next plan needs to test only the change

cards.title: Commit status
cards.text: A `pre-deploy-tests` status on the planned commit says how many sessions were planned. If it cannot be written, you are told; the plan still stands.

cards.title: Old files archived
cards.text: A new plan moves the earlier spec, sessions and bugs to `archive/<date>/`.

next_action.text: Open your app's repository and type `/pre-deploy-tests:plan`.
next_action.detail: Have the integration environment URL ready if you test there rather than on the default branch.
